areas.description: Stairway on the upper floor with a safety railing along the side. The stairs descend 20' to the ground floor at area #85. Ceilings on this floor are about 10' high.
Guest room serving as the residence of the female fighter and one of the male fighters met coming down the stairs in area #85. Furnished with a makeshift bed, table, chairs, and similar basics.
features: Locked casket with a crude lock intended mainly to show tampering

areas.description: Guest room occupied by one of the three fighters encountered on the stairs in area #85. Furnished with a makeshift bed, table, chairs, and such. A sack of valuables is hidden under the bed, and the room's owner keeps a pet snake there to guard it; it may immediately grab and pull under anyone who investigates unwisely.

encounters.count_note: Pet snake guarding the sack under the bed

treasure: A sack under the bed containing ten gems worth 50 gp each

areas.description: Guest room now used by one of the clerics as a private room; see area #106. It has makeshift furnishings including a bed, table, chairs, and similar basics. On a chest of drawers are religious items arranged in worshipful fashion around an evil golden icon.
treasure: Three silver holy symbols worth 25 gp each
A golden icon of an evil demonic being worth 100 gp
features: Religious display arranged on the chest of drawers

areas.description: Guest room claimed by one of the clerics as a private room; see area #106. It contains shabby, slapped-together furniture: bed, table, chairs, and such. A painting of horrors and stark terror hangs on one wall; it has little general value, though a good church might pay for it in order to destroy it or use it as an instructional example of evil. Beneath it hang looted religious valuables.
treasure: A holy symbol with several gems, valued at 250 gp
Three necklaces of gold and silver worth 50 gp each
A painting of horrors and stark terror that a church of good nature might buy for about 100 gp
features: Painting of horrors and stark terror hung on the wall

areas.description: Guest room now used by the Magic-User as a private room; see area #106. Furnishings are unremarkable: makeshift bed, table, chairs, and such. The beginnings of an alchemical laboratory for making potions are here, but it is incomplete.
features: Incomplete alchemical laboratory for making potions

areas.description: Guest room used as storage for various items kept for future use.
Former bedroom and nursery for children. The double doors to this room hang open. A few old toys and cribs lie scattered about under dust.

Lavish, very large former master room now serving as the headquarters and treasury of the band. The door is shut, and voices can be heard inside. Three humans are leaning over a map on a table, planning to use monsters to carve out their own empire; they attack intruders unless the intruders surrender. Several gaslights fed from natural gas taps illuminate the room. Furnishings are sparse because the old ones were looted long ago: a large round table, some chairs, and a desk. The nearby spell book of the magic-user contains the spells he knows.
areas.trap: A small bell hung from a rod on the inside near the top of the door jingles if the door is not opened carefully. The magic-user's spell book has a needle trap in the cover; save vs. Poison or die.
treasure: One chest with 1,230 gp, 456 sp, and 983 cp
One chest with 456 gp, 1,234 sp, and 491 pp
features: Door with a warning bell hung inside near the top
Several gaslights fed from natural gas taps
Two large chests holding war funds
